A practical Next.js tool that leverages OpenAI's API to translate code snippets between different programming languages. Built to explore AI integration patterns and solve real developer workflow challenges.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI API, Tailwind CSS

Useful for quickly migrating code examples or understanding equivalent syntax across languages.
